name: Hallstatt to the Skywalk and Salt Mine
why: Steep switchbacks from the lakeside village to the World Heritage viewpoint over the Hallstätter See and the world's oldest salt mine.
book: Free on foot; the funicular is paid. Arrive early: Hallstatt limits coaches and is packed by 10:00.

points.name: Hallstatt
points.note: The lakeside village of pastel houses under the cliffs.

points.name: Welterbeblick Skywalk
points.note: A platform over the cliff, 350 m above the lake.
